_meta.description: Cost sensitivity sweep on SOL/4h CombinedStrategy. Tests how Sharpe degrades with increased position-size (proxy for commission impact).

interpretation: Sharpe is mathematically leverage-invariant: ratio of mean return to volatility scales identically with position size. Returns scale linearly with size (+18% → +83% from 25% to 95%); drawdowns also scale linearly (-4% → -15%). The Sharpe 1.20 on SOL is REAL but is the result of a single coin and does not generalize (see walk_forward_crypto_combined.json — same coin avg Sharpe across 8 windows is +0.76, and 13/14 other coins are net negative). Position sizing is a separate risk-management decision; it does not create edge.
